edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier reads caller-controlled msg.sender to enforce owner authorization.
msg.sender is compared against the owner state variable in the access-control check.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
pause execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
unpause execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
blackListAddress execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transfer checks tokenBlacklist[msg.sender] and derives the debited balance from msg.sender.
transferFrom checks tokenBlacklist[msg.sender] and the allowance of msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance of the caller-controlled msg.sender.
burn passes caller-controlled msg.sender as the account to be burned.
burn delegates its logic to the internal _burn function.
PausableToken.transfer delegates to the inherited StandardToken.transfer.
PausableToken.transferFrom delegates to the inherited StandardToken.transferFrom.
blackListAddress delegates to the internal _blackList after owner and pause checks.
whenNotPaused modifier reads the paused state variable to gate transfer.
whenNotPaused modifier reads the paused state variable to gate blackListAddress.
pause sets the paused state variable to true.
unpause sets the paused state variable to false.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
transfer adds and subtracts entries in the balances mapping using SafeMath.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping using SafeMath add/sub.
transfer performs the balance ledger mutation classified as an unsafe arithmetic state update.
transferFrom performs the balance ledger mutation classified as an unsafe arithmetic state update.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub for the sender balance subtraction.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub and add for balance and allowance updates.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
mint calls SafeMath.add for totalSupply and balance increases.
_burn calls SafeMath.sub for balance and supply decreases.
transferFrom decrements the allowance entry of the spender.
approve writes a new allowance entry into the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval adds to the allowance entry in the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval subtracts from the allowance entry in the allowed mapping.
_blackList writes the target address flag into tokenBlacklist.
constructor computes _supply * 10**_decimals without SafeMath overflow protection.
the unchecked constructor product is assigned to totalSupply.
mint increases totalSupply, an unsafe supply-mutating arithmetic operation.
_burn decreases totalSupply, an unsafe supply-mutating arithmetic operation.
mint adds the minted amount to totalSupply.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from totalSupply.
constructor assigns the deployer-supplied tokenOwner to the owner state variable.
constructor writes the name state variable.
constructor writes the symbol state variable.
constructor writes the decimals state variable.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
Destination parameter flows into the credited balance entry in transfer.
Amount parameter flows into the SafeMath add/sub balance updates in transfer.
Source parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
Destination parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
Amount parameter flows into the SafeMath balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
Spender parameter is the key written into the allowed mapping by approve.
Allowance value parameter is stored directly by approve.
Spender parameter selects the allowance entry updated by increaseApproval.
Added value parameter flows into the SafeMath.add allowance update.
Spender parameter selects the allowance entry updated by decreaseApproval.
Subtracted value parameter flows into the SafeMath.sub allowance update.
Local oldValue snapshot is compared against the subtracted value to branch the allowance update.
Address parameter is the key written into tokenBlacklist by _blackList.
Boolean flag parameter is the value stored in tokenBlacklist by _blackList.
Address parameter is forwarded from blackListAddress into _blackList.
Boolean flag parameter is forwarded from blackListAddress into _blackList.
Name parameter is written into the name state variable by the constructor.
Symbol parameter is written into the symbol state variable by the constructor.
Decimals parameter is stored and used as the exponent of the unchecked supply multiplication.
Supply parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow protection.
Token owner parameter becomes the privileged owner and receives the initial balance.
Token owner parameter is credited with the entire totalSupply in the balances mapping.
Burn amount parameter flows into _burn and the SafeMath.sub supply reduction.
Account parameter selects the balance entry debited inside _burn.
Burn amount parameter flows into the SafeMath.sub balance and supply updates.
Account parameter is the balance entry credited by the owner-only mint.
Amount parameter flows into the SafeMath.add supply and balance increases in mint.
